enriched_activities.desc: Lie down in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Continue sleeping. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face with water. Dry face with towel. Pick up clothes. Put on clothes. Comb hair. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and making toast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Take out knife. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Remove toast from toaster. Place on plate. Spread butter on toast. Pour boiling water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag, checking phone for shift notes and reviewing the day's patient schedule on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open work bag. Place stethoscope in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open shift notes app. Read notes. Close app. Open calendar app. Check schedule. Close app. Put phone in bag. Turn on computer. Log in. Open patient schedule. Review schedule. Close computer. Turn off computer. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to facility. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, clinical documentation, medication rounds and coordinating with the care team
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at facility. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Review patient charts. Visit patient room 1. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Document notes. Visit patient room 2. Assist with mobility. Coordinate with nurse. Attend team meeting. Update care plan. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Visit patient room 3. Change wound dressing. Document. End shift. Clock out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the health care facility
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and oven, then eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn on oven. Place baking sheet with fish. Set timer. Wait. Turn off induction cooker. Remove pan. Place food on plate. Take fish out of oven. Place on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner, loading the dishwasher and wiping down the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from table. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load utensils. Load glasses. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up sponge. Wet sponge. Add soap. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Rinse sponge. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Get up to get snack. Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out snack. Walk back. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Get up.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing a load of laundry in the washing machine and running the clothes dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Open washing machine. Put clothes in. Add detergent. Close door. Turn on washing machine. Wait for wash cycle. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Put clothes in dryer. Close dryer door. Turn on dryer. Wait for dry cycle. Open dryer. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Put clothes away. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower with the water heater and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust shower temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Lather. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet wind-down time: reading and checking personal phone, dimming the bedroom light
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Dim main light. Pick up book. Read pages. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Scroll through social media. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes. Sleep.
Lie down in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Continue sleeping. Remain asleep.
